Fi: ActivityRestStrainPeriod is DAY/WEEK not DAILY; restFeed(period: DAY) = 24 positional hourly buckets from start (midnight owner zone), cursor ignored; stepFeed same shape; overnightRestSummary is an interface needing ... on ConcreteOvernightRestSummary and date = the daily window's start date; activityFeed(limit) has no cursor arg, Walk carries distance in metres and path {latitude longitude}.
Recent Tapo firmware authenticates the local control API as admin with the TP-Link cloud password, not the camera account; RTSP still uses the camera account. Third-Party Compatibility must be on.
OpenCV's RTSP reader queues frames; grab() until a grab blocks (>5 ms) is the cheap way to reach the live frame. The 8-second lag was queue depth, not network.
An element-level referrerPolicy on a Leaflet tile layer overrides the page's no-referrer header (carried from 09-11, still true).
